integrity: The proof is analytic for all m>=2; finite exact and numerical checks are supplementary. No independent external audit has been conducted. There is no claim of external certification or independently established novelty.
scientific_limitations: The complete multipartite spectral reduction and general SDP formulation are established prior work; the distinct result is uniqueness among every feasible kernel on K_{1,m,m}, not solely invariant kernels. Only symmetric stochastic transition matrices with uniform stationarity, loops allowed, and integer m>=2 are covered. Literature search cannot rule out unindexed equivalent uniqueness results.
title: Global uniqueness of fastest mixing on singleton-cone balanced bipartite graphs
